==English==
{{wp|+ (bone)}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:der|la:pubes<id:-is>|tree=1}}
Genitive of {{der|en|la|pubes|t=the pubic hair|pos=collective}}. The noun was generalized from medical Latin ''os pubis'', the [[pubic bone]].

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpju.bɪs/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Wodencafe-pubis.wav|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|pubes}}

# The [[pubic]] [[bone]]; the part of the [[hipbone]] forming the front [[arch]] of the [[pelvis]].
#: {{syn|en|pubic bone}}

* {{l|en|ischium}}
